correctness.rationale: Using the source's ring action and Gray map, the printed dual generators satisfy \(\xi_2\star g_2+x(\xi_2\star g_2)+g_1=(0\mid\xi_2(1+x))\), whose binary Gray image has weight two. An independent exact reconstruction of all cyclic-shift row spaces verified dimensions 29 and 20 for the displayed original and dual, all cross inner products zero, combined rank 48, hull dimension one, membership of the explicit word at Gray coordinates 41 and 42, absence of every unit vector, and exactly 36 weight-two dual words. Thus the displayed dual has minimum distance exactly two. Substitution into the source's Theorem 5.4 gives the displayed-data branch \([[49,19,2;28]]_2\).
risks: The correction concerns the generator exactly as printed; a typographical error could mean the authors intended a different code.
It does not rule out another \([[49,19,9;28]]_2\) construction.
